race.comment: Wary of the first starters but CARTIER GLOW (11) has some good form on the board and looks close to a win. Fourth here on debut then led and was run down late when beaten only half a length last time at Northam. Very well weighted with the claim for Pang and drawn to ping the gates and take control. Looks the one to run down. VINO MISS (8) was well off best last time when eighth here after getting well back. Strong fourth the start prior. Has ability and if they go hard will be winding up strongly. PROPHECY GIRL (13) started 20/1 at Ascot on debut as a juvenile. Not disgraced and put away again. Fitter for two trials and returning in easier with the blinkers added. Expected to measure up to this level. LUNARIS (14) is a filly by So You Think making debut. From a big family of winners. Watch for a move. CHAMPAGNE TALKS (7) went back to last off the outside gate last time and well worth another chance.
